title: The Sap Trees
text: A grove of pale trees bleeds golden sap from every crack in the bark. It runs thick and slow, smelling of honey and something like blood. Alchemists pay well for it. The trees shiver when they are cut.

options.label: Tap the trees for sap; alchemists pay well for gold that bleeds.

outcomes.text: You fill jars with it, warm and golden. The trees shiver for each one.

options.label: Fell the pale trees for both timber and sap.

outcomes.text: Each trunk makes a sound as it falls.

options.label: The wisest takes seedlings for the House, to grow a grove of its own.

outcomes.text: In time a grove grows that bleeds gold. Nobody likes to walk in it after dark.
